b:
Let the sky pour

The outpouring
of sorrow,
poems of joy

Opening the doorway of the clouds
she stands there
soft as cotton

The sky's waves of water,
a peacock

A four-line poem

Her body made of whiteness
under the umbrella
of the clouds

The roaring waves
are defeated
by her laughter

The eyebrows
curved like a bow
imprison
the arrows of her eyes

the instant
she
blinks
